articles.title: White House pushes Senate Democrats to take 'historic' crypto Clarity Act ethics deal
articles.snippet: Without revealing any details about the actual agreement from President Trump on potential presidential restrictions, his White House is urging its acceptance.

articles.title: Clarity odds jump to 43% on Polymarket after unverified reports Trump agreed to ethics deal
articles.snippet: Bettors moved the crypto market structure bill to a 43% chance of passing this year, up from a record low last week, though no bill text has appeared.

articles.title: Crypto markets rally on Clarity progress report, Asian chip-stock rebound
articles.snippet: Speculation that President Donald Trump agreed to a crucial ethics provision for the crypto market structure bill underpinned the gains.

articles.title: Live markets: Bitcoin pulls back from five-week high on new Trump threats over Iran
articles.snippet: Bitcoin ETFs have pulled in roughly $727 million over the past week, the most sustained stretch of buying since the record outflows of June.

articles.title: Bitcoin nears seven-week high as stocks ignore Iran strikes, Trump 10% tariff plans
articles.snippet: Bitcoin and crypto joined US stocks in brushing off US-Iran war escalation and the threat of fresh trade tariffs before the end of the month.
